notes: Bullion (kulce) gold/silver delivery is VAT-exempt (KDV 17/4-g). Jewelry uses a special base: the bullion value is deducted and 20% VAT applies only to the remainder (making charge/margin). Quarter/half/Republic coins and 22K bracelets are popular; shops deduct making charges when buying back. No sourced premium, making or buyback percentages.

sources.name: Alomaliye - Kuyumculuk sektorunde KDV uygulamasi (2025)
